API ReferenceZIdentity APIResource ServersResource Servers Ops Get
Resource Servers Ops Get
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/resource-servers/:id

Retrieves details about a specific resource server using the server ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the resource server to retrieve.

Responses
​
200
401

The request was successful, and the resource server details are returned.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the resource server.

name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the resource server.

displayName
string
REQUIRED

The display name of the resource server.

description
string
REQUIRED

A description about the resource server.

primaryAud
string
REQUIRED

The primary audience of the resource server, identifying the primary entity or context for which the server is intended.

defaultApi
boolean
REQUIRED

Whether this resource server is set as the default API.

serviceScopes
object[]
REQUIRED
]
